Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. I can't meet the request as written, and I can't confirm anything from this message. Nothing is held. The listed prices are fixed, so I can't set a different total price.

**Why it can't be met:** BrightRoom's largest venue is the Loft, which holds a maximum of 24 people. Your group is 50. The Studio holds a maximum of 12, so it doesn't fit either. Because no venue fits, I can't build a package that fits your budget.

You didn't mention a duration or any extras. I assumed one standard 4-hour block and the venue only. Our bookings are all 4 hours, and there is no longer option.

**One option you could consider.** You would need to agree to the changes it involves:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Loft | 24 | €420 | headcount reduced from 50 to at most 24; budget raised from €100 to €420 (+€320) |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



This option gives up two things. The group would shrink from 50 to at most 24 people. The cost would also be higher than your budget, as the table shows.

Please note that the dates need a separate availability check. Please tell me your preferred dates, whether you can reduce the group size, and whether you need catering, a projector or a facilitator. If you need to split the 50 people across several sessions, please get in touch. Each session would be a separate booking that would have to be priced on its own.

Kind regards

grade.reason: The reply refuses to confirm the booking or the €100 total. It says no venue fits 50 people. It offers the Loft at €420 for at most 24 people as an alternative that needs client consent, which is correctly priced and doesn't break the rules. It doesn't claim availability, and it doesn't present the €420 as the price of the 50-person event.
